name: stt-bench
description: stt-bench is a community-hosted speech-to-text benchmark dataset for evaluating automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. It provides audio samples paired with reference transcriptions and is intended for quick comparisons of ASR model performance across common scenarios. The dataset is hosted on Hugging Face and is suitable for measuring transcription quality using standard ASR metrics.
reputation: A small community dataset on Hugging Face used for quick ASR comparisons; useful for rapid prototyping but not a canonical, heavily cited benchmark.
